run.title: LongMemEval-S Phase 2 intended-stack pilot
run.goal: Lock the 10-case intended-stack pilot plan after Phase 1 passed on the GPT-5-family stack.

decisions.purpose: internal intended-stack infrastructure and quality pilot
decisions.not_a_score_reason: This is a 10-case deterministic pilot with bounded haystacks and capped scalar gold answers. It is not statistically representative and must not be reported as an official or partial LongMemEval-S score.

intended_stack.caveat: Strict preflight requires active API and Durable settings to stamp a fixed 2000-call ingest budget via min=max=2000. Worker summarization still resolves through default for some materialization paths; artifacts must report observed telemetry, not just configured role env.

selection.selection_strategy: Inherited deterministic pre-Phase-1 selection: one pseudo-random case per question type, then deterministic SHA256(seed+case_id) fill to 10. Reused to avoid post-Phase-1 reselection bias.
selection.session_slice_policy: Use first 8 haystack sessions plus all answer sessions, filled to 9 sessions max when fewer than 9 are selected.
selection.gold_answer_policy: Scalar gold answers up to 320 characters.
selection.policy_caveat: The session and gold caps preserve continuity with the pre-Phase-1 pilot. The 50-case subset should revisit these caps before using results as a stronger quality/performance signal.

advance_to_50_case_subset_if.pipeline_eligibility_policy: Two cases are calibration-only because they require harness intervention: 8e91e7d9 uses evidence minimization with synthetic sibling-total evidence, and 195a1a1b uses assistant-advice context extraction. The green-light gate therefore requires all 8 unmodified pipeline-eligible cases to complete, with at least 7 judged correct.

abort_rules: Abort on any new Service Bus DLQ message.
Abort on any Durable instance ending Failed, Terminated, or Canceled.
Abort on any answer-bearing content-filter block.
Abort on repeated model 429/rate-limit failures after configured retries.
Abort if a case exceeds 90 minutes without checkpoint progress.
Abort if a residue probe returns facts or answer content from a previous synthetic user.

decisions.next_gate: Plan the 50-case subset with the Phase 2 pilot caveats carried forward.

isolation: fresh benchmark synthetic user per case using auth_mode=dev; dispatch_mode=servicebus; no clear-per-case
